content: How to add short-term memory to your AI agent (Sessions & State Explained) Learn how to pass information between agents with agent short term memory. Annie breaks down short-term memory for AI agents using Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), including how sessions, events, and state work together to keep your agent context aware.
